results.headline: Clogau Gold Mine Operations and Exploration Update
results.key_quote: The current ladder-and-platform installation serves a different and more immediate purpose. results.headline: Interim Results for six months ended 30 June 2026
results.key_quote: H1 2026 proved to be a successful and exciting period for CAML, as we achieved a solid production performance against a positive background of high metals prices... Group EBITDA to $75.5 million, an 89% increase over the corresponding period of last year, resulting in an EBITDA margin of more than 50%... free cash flow generation almost trebled, to $46.8 million
results.summary: Central Asia Metals delivered substantially ahead of expectations in H1 2026. Revenue increased 46% to $145.5m, EBITDA surged 89% to $75.5m with margins expanding to 52% from 40%, and profit before tax jumped 203% to $59.3m. Free cash flow nearly tripled to $46.8m. The company is on track to meet full-year guidance across all three metal products and announced a major acquisition (Cygnus Metals) to materially expand copper exposure. Strong balance sheet with $97.2m cash. The only negative was two lost time injuries compared to zero in H1 2025.

results.headline: Update on Sanankoro Financing

results.headline: Lithium Ridge Drill Results
results.key_quote: Intersecting over 24 metres at 2.00% Li₂O in drill hole LRD097 is a milestone achievement that fundamentally enhances the scale and grade profile of the asset, showing continued potential at depth.
results.summary: Andrada announced the fourth batch of drill results from the Lithium Ridge Project confirming high-grade lithium mineralisation across multiple drill holes, with drill hole LRD097 delivering 24.08m @ 2.00% Li₂O - described by the CEO as a 'milestone achievement' that 'fundamentally enhances the scale and grade profile of the asset'. The results demonstrate continued depth potential and robust polymetallic economic potential through associated tin and tantalum enrichment. The CEO's commentary emphasizes these are 'exceptional drill results' confirming 'world-class potential' and validating the aggressive exploration strategy.

Drill results described as 'exceptional' and 'milestone achievement'

results.headline: Half year results publication – Gatwick Airport
results.key_quote: London Gatwick delivered a solid operational and financial performance for the first half of 2026, with revenue and EBITDA both up
results.summary: Gatwick Airport reported solid H1 2026 results with revenue up 4.8% to £515.2m and EBITDA up 5.5% to £276.5m. Passenger numbers declined 4.7% to 19.1m due to Middle East conflict and low-cost carrier capacity reductions, but the airport expanded its airline network with seven new carriers joining and maintained strong operational performance (95% security throughput in 5 minutes or less, 99% of passenger service measures met). The Northern Runway Programme received final approval after an eight-year legal and planning process. Results are described as 'solid' performance despite a 'challenging geopolitical and economic backdrop', indicating performance met or slightly exceeded expectations given headwinds.
